title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. Consider how increasing the number of replicates might affect the variability of the sample mean.

title: Effect of Increasing Replicates
text: Increasing the number of bootstrap replicates generally provides a more accurate estimate of the sampling distribution. Think about how this might influence the variance of the sample mean.

title: Analyzing Variance
text: What happens to the variance of the sample mean when you increase the number of bootstrap replicates?
